sloka: आदित्यमभिवाश्यन्ति जनयन्तो महद्भयम् ।दीना दीनस्वरा घोरा अप्रशस्ता मृगद्विजाः ।। ६.४१.१६ ।।।।
transliteration: ādityamabhivāśyanti janayanto mahadbhayam ।dīnā dīnasvarā ghorā apraśastā mṛgadvijāḥ ।। 6.41.16 ।।।।

translations.english: "The desperate inauspicious sounds of ominous beasts crying pitifully facing the sun are causing great fear."
